advisories: Optional (OverlapESDInput / esd_overlap.py): the design says sec crops are resampled via resample_complex_deramped_reramp from the full-burst deramped secondary, but does not state the azimuth/range halo used when cropping at the window edges. Lanczos taps near a bare crop edge would read zero padding and depress coherence statistics on border multilook cells. Since the full-burst arrays are already in memory in the consensus pass, cropping with a small halo (>= Lanczos radius + max offset) before resampling is nearly free; state it in the design or leave it to the TDD tests, but the per-overlap coherence gate statistics should not silently include edge-contaminated cells.

Optional (Risks, wrap-ambiguity mitigation): the mitigation text says the estimator runs after 'geometry+Ampcor pre-alignment', but under the TOPS policy the azimuth pre-alignment is geometry-only: Ampcor azimuth is measured and deliberately not applied (missions/s1/processing.py line 2041 amp_res_az = 0.0; the proposal's own non-goal 'No Ampcor azimuth apply'). With overlap responses of ~40-60 rad/px the wrap boundary at ~0.1-0.16 px rests entirely on dense-geometry azimuth accuracy. The design already pins near-wrap and beyond-wrap shifts synthetically and carries per-overlap spread diagnostics; recommend the real-S1 qualification record explicitly reports the per-overlap spread as the geometry-only wrap sanity check, and that the risk wording be corrected to 'geometry (azimuth) + range Ampcor'.

Optional (AC-2 residual edge, no design change needed): the split-band estimator itself still returns a 0-shift/0-coherence ESDResult when no valid samples exist (esd.py lines 181-189). This predates the proposal and AC-5 correctly keeps split-band behavior unchanged, but when auto falls back to split-band on QC-empty overlaps, a fully decorrelated pair can still produce az=0 with the legacy sigma-1.0 arc fallback in measure_misreg. A state.note on the split-band fallback path (mirroring the F4 observability intent) would keep the measure trail honest; not required for AC-2, which governs the overlap dispatch path.
notes: Revision 2 verification against code. F1 closed: the proposed entry (produce_interferogram_pair gains esd_method; today it has only esd_enabled, missions/s1/processing.py line 4138) extends the existing multi-burst consensus pass exactly as designed: that pass already measures per burst with residuals_only=True (processing.py lines 4633-4696), pools residuals, and injects the aggregate through force_esd_azimuth_shift_px into the production pass (lines 4721-4724, 4793-4794); the seam consumes a forced ESD shift verbatim (lines 2052-2055), so measuring per BurstOverlapWindow in this pass and skipping per-burst split-band is a structural fit, not new plumbing. F2 closed: the binding burst-absolute row0/col0/native_height triple matches the real signatures (tops_carrier_phase and reramp accept row0/col0/native_height; carrier_phase_at_points requires centre_row explicitly), and the crop hazard is real exactly as claimed: native_height=None yields centre_row = crop_height // 2 in both tops_carrier_phase (tops/deramp.py line 118) and resample_complex_deramped_reramp (offsets.py line 2566); deramp() (tops/deramp.py lines 223-261) has no coordinate parameters at all, so 'never deramp() a crop' is enforced by the API itself; row0 is added once at true source coordinates in resample_complex_deramped_reramp (offsets.py line 2591). AC-4 pins the regression including the omitted-native_height case. F3 closed: the existing ESD measurement pre-align already applies geometry + range-Ampcor offsets only (processing.py lines 2059-2067) with Ampcor azimuth forced to zero under TOPS policy (line 2041); residuals_only=True returns before the final resample (lines 2158-2182); ESD and misreg date constants enter only combine_offset_fields in the apply resample (geometry_coreg.py lines 191-263), and the network apply pass runs with ESD measurement disabled and constants applied (session.py lines 2487-2491, 2565-2568). F4 closed: estimate_overlap_esd returns None (never a record with a 0 shift) when no sample passes the coherence gate, auto falls back to split-band with a state note, explicit overlap fails closed via reject_invalid_state at both the no-overlap and no-qualifying-samples decision points, and the dispatch verification matrix covers both fail-closed cases plus the fallback for pair and network paths. Structural checks: the esd_on tautology exists as claimed (session.py line 2378); EsdMethod = Literal['auto','splitband','overlap'] is declared but currently neither validated nor dispatched (config.py lines 32, 64); MisregArc already carries method/n_valid and _load_arcs constructs MisregArc(**row) (misreg_network.py lines 23-36, session.py lines 4675-4677), so keeping arcs.json rows MisregArc-shaped while persisting per-overlap diagnostics in a separate esd_overlap_diagnostics.json is the correct call; the S1 annotation inputs burst_overlap_windows needs (S1Burst.azimuth_time/first_valid_sample/last_valid_sample, S1Swath.azimuth_time_interval_s/lines_per_burst/samples_per_burst) all exist in missions/s1/types.py; the rename plan is compatible since faninsar.processing.coregistration.__init__ re-exports ESDResult/estimate_azimuth_shift_esd and downstream consumers import via the package path; the real-S1 qualification's requirement of >= 2 adjacent bursts correctly targets the _burst_kwargs default of first-burst-only selection (session.py lines 1816-1818); the R_B = 2*pi*dt*(f_top - f_bot) response divisor is consistent with the implemented carrier (carrier_phase_at_points evaluates pi*Kt*(eta-eta_ref)^2 + 2*pi*f_dc*eta, whose eta-derivative is the full instantaneous frequency Kt*(eta-eta_ref) + f_dc, matching the design's 'full carrier, never f_dc alone' contract). MVP/complexity gate: every added element (esd_overlap/esd_common modules, mission-owned window geometry, dispatch helper, one shared coherence knob, one state field, diagnostics JSON) maps to a confirmed AC; no speculative layering. Module placement matches the post-P0050 ownership map (mission geometry in missions/s1, scientific estimator in processing/coregistration, dispatch in stack). No Necessary issue found; verdict recommend-accept with three Optional advisories.
